gui.portablestorage.settings.title: Portable Storage Settings
gui.portablestorage.settings.storage_pos: Sets the position of the warehouse relative to the inventory screen.
gui.portablestorage.settings.offset_inve: If enabled, shifts the inventory screen to make room for the warehouse. If disabled, the inventory remains centered.
gui.portablestorage.settings.show_small_: Shows the 5 quick setting buttons on the warehouse sidebar (Sort, Quick Transfer, etc.).
gui.portablestorage.settings.remove_expe: Removes the confirmation screen when loading worlds with experimental features.
gui.portablestorage.settings.auto_fold_o: Automatically folds the warehouse when closing the inventory or a container.
gui.portablestorage.settings.sort_mode.d: Choose how items are sorted in the warehouse.
Choose between Ascending and Descending sorting order.
gui.portablestorage.settings.quick_inter: Enables Shift-Clicking to easily transfer items between your inventory and the warehouse.
gui.portablestorage.settings.smart_colla: Automatically collapses similar items into single stacks to make the UI more compact.
gui.portablestorage.settings.craft_refil: Automatically refills ingredients from the warehouse when crafting.
gui.portablestorage.settings.uncondition: Sets whether new players have the warehouse enabled by default. NONE: Requires item, BASE: Basic warehouse, FULL: Full warehouse.
gui.portablestorage.settings.base_wareho: The item ID required to unlock the Base Warehouse. Default: minecraft:heart_of_the_sea
gui.portablestorage.settings.full_wareho: The item ID required to unlock the Full Warehouse. Default: minecraft:nether_star
gui.portablestorage.settings.hopper_rang: The radius in which the Hopper Upgrade picks up dropped items. Default: 5
gui.portablestorage.settings.hopper_freq: How often the Hopper Upgrade attempts to pick up items. Default: 1.0s
gui.portablestorage.settings.enable_3x3_: Upgrades the 2x2 inventory crafting grid to 3x3 if the Workbench Upgrade is active.
gui.portablestorage.settings.drop_storag: If keepInventory is false, the warehouse is locked on death and drops a key.
gui.portablestorage.settings.allow_hot_r: Allows OPs to edit server configs in-game. Warning: Changing server configs at runtime might cause issues!
gui.portablestorage.settings.max_item_nb: Max allowed NBT size (in bytes) per item. Default: 10240 (10KB). -1 for unlimited.
gui.portablestorage.settings.server_limi: Storage limit determined by the server. -1 for unlimited.
gui.portablestorage.settings.lava_infini: If lava exceeds this amount, it becomes infinite. Default: 10000 (-1 to disable).
gui.portablestorage.settings.water_infin: If water exceeds this amount, it becomes infinite. Default: 2 (-1 to disable).

upgrade.portablestorage.rift.name: Rift Upgrade
upgrade.portablestorage.rift.desc: §7Tears a rift to your private pocket dimension.
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_upgrad: The item ID used for the Rift Upgrade. Default: minecraft:dragon_egg
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_chunk_: The size of your personal Rift dimension in chunks. Default: 1 (1x1 chunk).
gui.portablestorage.settings.enable_rift: Forces the Rift chunks to stay loaded for online players.
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_forced: Radius of chunks to force load around the center. Default: 1.
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_plot_s: Spacing between player Rift plots in chunks. Default: 64.
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_floor_: The default Y-level of the stone block when creating a new Rift plot. Default: 64.
gui.portablestorage.settings.enable_rift: Leaves an Avatar behind in the real world when entering the Rift.
Restricts players to their own Rift plot using world borders.
gui.portablestorage.settings.rift_border: Distance at which the screen tints red near the Rift border. 0 to disable.
